name: Nishizawa Ayumu
source:
Likes: Delicious and sweet food
Dislikes: Unknown

Ayumu is a girl from Hayate's previous school, Shiomi High School. She has had a crush on Hayate ever since their first meeting, but could never get the courage to confess while he was around at school. She violently lashes out at anyone who badmouths her and Hayate despite her kind appearance.

[From [url=http://hayatenogotoku.wikia.com/wiki/Ayumu]Hayate no Gotoku Wiki[/url]]
